newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nedbank cuts fixed rate mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: Nedbank cuts fixed rate mortgage rates.

text.p: South African bank Nedcor Ltd said on Thursday its Nedbank and Permanent Bank units would be reducing the rate on fixed-rate residential mortgages to 18 percent from 19 percent, with immediate effect.
The cut, applicable to 12- and 24-month fixed-rate options, follows similar reductions in fixed rate loans by Standard Bank and Amalgamated Banks of South Africa.
Economists say the cuts reflect growing confidence that the Reserve Bank will reduce the official Bank rate from 17 to 16 percent later this year.
